title: Scalar-unit compatibility of strict open reduction towers
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and an open immersion j:U→X. For any fixed compatible ordinary open operations o and their normalized finite coefficient tensor comparison tc, there exist ScalarCompatibility sc and ScalarComparison r [def-sf-open-tensor-quotient-data]. For every unbounded completed-coefficient complex P on U, the scalar-adjunction unit on j_!P followed by r equals extension of the scalar-adjunction unit on P (using the canonical constant-functor comparison). All strict quotient transitions, finite comparison components and systems evaluation equations are retained. No tensor comparison square, balancing isomorphism or completion presentation is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; scalar extension and restriction, Tags 03DI and 03EK; strict systems, Tag 0941. Strict cochain specialization.

proof.text: On the ambient slice at the open object, scalar restriction leaves each extension-presheaf summand and insertion unchanged. The identity on summands, followed by sheafification, constructs the finite comparison. The same construction on whole semilinear coefficient systems commutes with every transition and gives the systems comparison and its finite evaluation formula. Transport using the coefficient equivalences of o. Their pushforward and projection equations identify both scalar actions.

Compose tc.ordinary at each coefficient level with the finite scalar restriction comparison, term by term. The generator formulas commute with quotient maps, so these maps assemble into a natural isomorphism of strict towers. This gives r and its required components field.

The actual scalar-adjunction unit sends x to 1 tensor x. Its consecutive transition equality follows because quotient maps preserve 1, hence gives scalarUnitTower. On an extension summand the normalized generator formula of tc sends this unit to the unit of the same summand. The scalar comparison is identity on that summand. Summand/sheafification extensionality proves the unit equation in every degree; complex and tower extensionality assemble it. The construction works for negative degrees, zero complexes, the empty open and identity open.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarUnitCompatibility
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o) :
    ∃ (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o) (r : ScalarComparison l E j o sc tc),
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ,
        scalarUnitTower l E X ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj P) ≫
            r.iso.hom.app P =
          (Functor.constComp ℕᵒᵖ P (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)).inv ≫
            Functor.whiskerRight (scalarUnitTower l E U P)
              (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)
